method: Exactly two fresh sequential native Sol reviewers, two terminal ordinary attempts each; visible-only synthetic pause-assisted control, held-input capture available. Different players/routes/control mistakes, no causal balance comparison.

gameplay.rationale: Clear recover-and-extract loop, precise weakpoint opportunities and consequential positioning. Surrounding pressure was punishing and my stationary defense failed; control limitations and unused dash constrain difficulty judgment.
gameplay.coverage: Two deaths, all receiver recoveries and partial extraction defense; no win.

presentation.rationale: Cohesive atmospheric lighting, weather, typography and composition; simple geometry and restrained visual variety limit finish.
presentation.coverage: Menu, handbook, main facility routes, ADS, damage and death screens; audio unassessed.

usability.rationale: Visible controls, paused map, objective distances and explicit interaction/uplink feedback let me progress independently. Tight receiver and deck positioning needed corrections.
usability.coverage: Handbook, deploy/redeploy, pause, map, movement, fire/ADS, reload, sprint, recover and upload.

readability.rationale: Large HUD numbers, labels and amber optics read well; small low-contrast helper text and concurrent directional/marker information made precise threat interpretation harder.
readability.coverage: 1280x800 screenshots during entry, yard, triage and extraction combat.

aaaReadiness.rationale: A coherent playable slice with working loop and useful feedback, but observed geometry, enemy variety, visual feedback density and limited completed content do not support finished AAA readiness.
aaaReadiness.coverage: Provisional whole-slice impression from two ordinary attempts; successful finale, sound, hardware performance and long-term depth unassessed.

attempts.coverage: Entry guard, west approach and triage, West Archive recovery, Heart guard and recovery, East Archive recovery, sprint return, uplink entry, upload, outside pause/decay and reentry, death screen.
attempts.finale: Reached uplink; screenshot showed 92% before terminal death. No completion behavior observed.

attempts.coverage: Entry guard, east lane and East Archive recovery, Heart guard and attempted receiver recovery, death screen.

gameplay.rationale: Compact objective loop supports alternate routes, optic combat, movement and cover; the upload finale punished exposure. Both wins were possible with few kills, so pressure may be permissive. Pause-assisted inputs limit difficulty judgment.
gameplay.coverage: Two complete wins, all receivers and finale; no death or successful charge-break observed.

presentation.rationale: Strong title/end typography, wet industrial palette and relay landmark; simple geometric weapon, enemies and repeated structures keep the scene visibly at vertical-slice level.
presentation.coverage: Title, handbook, records, first-person areas and victory screens; visual only.

usability.rationale: Controls, map, distances, recovery correction and extraction edge feedback supported completion. Reach/ring estimation and navigation around solid cover needed repeated correction.
usability.coverage: Handbook, map, pause/resume, recovery, reload and upload. Settings untouched.

readability.rationale: Major objectives, vitals and archive signs read clearly; small hints and threat cues compete with geometry, rain and multiple labels. Enemy optic precision required close observation.
readability.coverage: 1280x800 captures through two missions; no accessibility settings inspection.

aaaReadiness.rationale: A coherent playable slice with a complete loop and polished framing, but observed environment/enemy/weapon detail, short mission scope and limited encountered interaction variety do not establish broad AAA readiness.
aaaReadiness.coverage: Two complete ordinary attempts only; no audio, performance, extensive robustness or content-scale validation.
